text: Architecture proposal: session-scoped storage layout. Thread a scopeKey ({runtime, sessionId}) through resolveStateDir() — the single choke point in goal-core.cjs. Every lifecycle function (readGoalRecord, setGoal, recordTurn, clearGoal, completeGoal, pauseGoal, resumeGoal) inherits isolation through resolveStateDir's pass-through. Opaque filename rule: <runtime>-<sha256(sessionId)>.json. No runtime exposes a hook-accessible session ID, so sessionId is operator-supplied (--session flag) with "default" fallback for backward compatibility.

Migration strategy: 4-phase plan. Phase 1: detect legacy active-goal.json, archive contents to .archive/.legacy/, rename to .legacy-active-goal.json, write .migration-complete marker. Phase 2: per-session file creation on setGoal with sessionId. Phase 3: adapter threading — Pi and Cursor adapters pass sessionId through rawOptions. Phase 4: resume/fork semantics — same scope key = same file (resume); different scope key = different file (fork). Backward compatibility via "default" sessionId for operators who never use --session.

Objective verification plan: 4 stages. Stage 1: 6-cell two-session cross-runtime action matrix (Pi×Pi, Pi×Cursor, Cursor×Pi, Cursor×Cursor with different sessionIds + same-session overwrite controls). Stage 2: 5 negative controls (recordTurn, completeGoal, clearGoal, pauseGoal/resumeGoal, verifyGoalHeuristic — all isolated). Stage 3: 7 regression controls (single-session backward compat, CLI compat, archive listing, mk-goal untouched, migration idempotency, env isolation). Stage 4: 7-point final gate (all stages pass, no real .goal-state/ touched, legacy tests unchanged, 2 new test files exist, migration idempotent).

Implementation risk surface: 2 core function signature changes (resolveStateDir + setGoal), 3 path-resolution changes (archiveGoalRecord, listArchivedGoals, resolveStateDir), 3 adapter threading changes (bin/goal.cjs, goal-context.ts, goal-inject.mjs). All other lifecycle functions inherit isolation through resolveStateDir pass-through — no signature changes needed. Approximately 200-300 lines of changed code bounded to a single architectural choke point.

Synthesis alignment: all P0/P1 requirements addressed. REQ-001 (3 iterations): completed. REQ-002 (verified evidence): every finding cites current source lines. REQ-003 (session identity): architecture scopes by operator-supplied sessionId with --session. REQ-004 (migration contract): full 4-phase plan with scope key, opaque filenames, quarantine, resume/fork semantics. REQ-005 (Devin truth): resolved iter 2 — decommissioned, do not restore. REQ-006 (proof plan): 4-stage, 13-assertion verification matrix with 7-point final gate.
